sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Monster Round are simple yet challenging. Players must navigate a ball through a series of obstacles and enemies, all while trying to collect as many points as possible. The ball can be controlled using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it easy to play on any device.

One of the key aspects of Monster Round is its use of obstacles and enemies. The obstacles can be moved and manipulated using the player's mouse or finger, while the enemies are stationary and must be avoided. As the game progresses, the obstacles and enemies become increasingly difficult, requiring players to think strategically and react quickly.

The gameplay is also heavily dependent on timing and reaction speed. Players must time their movements perfectly to avoid obstacles and enemies, and react quickly to changing situations. This requires a high level of focus and concentration, making the game both challenging and rewarding.
